body:
- Few of the BGP operational data are missing as part of show bgp vrfs
vrf-id neighbor <neighbor-id> json and non-json output.

 - Removed the rxMinInterval, txMinInterval and detectMultiplier form the
json and non-json output at ospf and bgp neighbor commands.


Commands supported:

```
show bgp vrf default neighbors  <neighbor-id> json
show bgp vrf default neighbors  <neighbor-id>
```



```
show ip ospf vrf <vrf-id> neighbor <neighbor-id> detail json
show bgp vrf <vrf-id> neighbors <neighbor-id> json
```


Signed-off-by: Sindhu Parvathi Gopinathan's <sgopinathan@nvidia.com>
title: Add missing fields for show bgp neighbor command
